rv.q: But as a faith-based, pageant-like musical, a tradition with longstanding roots, it's an arresting experience that clearly moved very many of my fellow theatergoers on Thursday night, a group that included several nuns.
Surprisingly and refreshingly, “Bernadette, The Musical” does not preach.
BERNADETTE, THE MUSICAL is a spiritual experience, regardless of one’s religious beliefs.
However, this production falls short on too many other markers of quality musical theater to win me over.

This is the story of thirteen or fourteen-year-old Bernadette Soubirous, whose unshakeable faith, resilience, conviction, and strength in the face of denunciation and vicious attacks enabled her to stand her ground.
I did love the story and feel that you do not have to be religious to enjoy the music and story-telling.

cn.t: Critics find this sincere retelling of Saint Bernadette's story visually striking and emotionally moving, though some question whether its earnest faith-based approach translates beyond religious audiences.
